headline: Graphic Designer
tagline: Graphic designer with 1.5 years of experience delivering brand-consistent visual collateral and marketing campaigns.

skills.label: Design & Visuals
skills.items: Figma, Illustrator, Photoshop, CorelDRAW, branding and visual identity, typography, layout, visual hierarchy

skills.label: Collateral & Production
skills.items: Print production, print-ready file management, social and marketing creative, presentations, banners

skills.label: Workflow & Tools

experience.title: Graphic Designer
bullets: Produced 100+ digital and print creatives spanning employee engagement, branding, recruitment, onboarding, and corporate communications.
Built reusable design templates and visual systems that cut turnaround time and repetitive work.
Designed banners, standees, certificates, ID cards, presentations, and marketing collateral.
Worked closely with HR and management stakeholders, achieving low revision cycles.
Managed print-ready files including bleed, sizing, and colour accuracy, applying principles of typography, colour systems, layout, and visual hierarchy.
Utilised AI-assisted workflows including ChatGPT and Adobe Firefly for ideation and exploration.

experience.title: UI/UX Designer
bullets: Conducted usability testing, feeding findings back into user flows and interface usability.
Created wireframes and prototypes for early-stage digital products.
Developed logos, visual identity systems, and brand guidelines for early-stage businesses.
Designed social campaigns, branding assets, and brochures for startups and SMBs.
Collaborated with developers and stakeholders on design-to-development handoff using Photoshop and Illustrator.

projects.name: Social Campaign for a Fashion Brand
bullets: Executed an Instagram and Facebook series that drove a 15% increase in follower engagement.

projects.name: Branding Kit for AT Creation Startup
bullets: Developed logo, typography, and palette guidelines for an early-stage startup.
